silo.name: SILO Data Drill, Queensland Government (Long Paddock)
silo.credit: Climate data: SILO, Queensland Government (© State of Queensland), CC BY 4.0, built from Bureau of Meteorology observations. The data has been reformatted.

sourceCodeMeanings.25: Interpolated from daily observations for that date.
sourceCodeMeanings.26: Synthetic Class A pan evaporation, calculated from temperatures, radiation and vapour pressure. Every FAO-56 value in this pull carries this code.
sourceCodeMeanings.75: Interpolated from the long term averages of daily observations for that day of year. Seen on the last few days before a pull, until the observations arrive.

silo.note: Reformatted: one file per district, six variables, source-code columns counted in this manifest and then dropped. Values as served. Data Drill values are interpolated to a 0.05 degree grid, so they are not a single station.

mla.name: Meat & Livestock Australia, National Livestock Reporting Service, public statistics service
mla.credit: Reproduced courtesy of Meat & Livestock Australia Limited – www.mla.com.au
mla.note: Reformatted: values rounded to 2 decimal places, head to whole numbers, one file per series. Daily rows as served. An indicator row holds the last 7 days of sales, so a value repeats until the next sale.
